• Crypto total market cap fell 14.5% over 30D: Total crypto market cap at $2.50T (14.5% lower over 30D). Related: FSB urges Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules (CoinTelegraph).
  • Losses broadened among top-50 alts: 3 names up more than ~0.5%, 35 down more than ~0.5%, and 3 roughly flat out of 41 non-stable coins with a valid 1M % (top-50 table). Related: Nomura weighs Laser Digital sale as European losses hit four straight quarters (CoinDesk).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions (CoinTelegraph).
  • Regulatory framing still decides product access: Enforcement and legislation shocks tend to pull risk into majors first, while higher-beta categories retrace until policy clarity returns. Related: DTCC Plans Solana Expansion as Wallet Rules Limit Access (CoinTelegraph).
